cues: Pseudostratified epithelium is a trick of the eye.
The cells are of different heights, so their nuclei sit at two levels and the sheet looks layered.
But every single cell stands on the basement membrane.
It lines the trachea and the nose.
text: Pseudostratified epithelium is a trick of the eye. The cells are of different heights, so their nuclei sit at two levels and the sheet looks layered. But every single cell stands on the basement membrane. It is one layer thick. It lines the trachea and the nose.
